d: Bihar MLC Controversy : bihar vidhan parishad ke do nirdaliy MLC vanshidhar brajvasi aur rahul raj ko bari rahat mili hai... donon ki sadasyata radd karne ki mang ko lekar RJD aur jan suraj ki or se dakhil yachikaon ko vidhan parishad sachivalay ne kharij kar diya hai...donon netaon ne nirdaliy pratyashi ke taur par chunav jita tha... iske bad patna sthit BJP karyalay men unki maujudgi aur parti se najdiki dikhane vali tasviron ke samne aane par vivad shuru huaa... vipaksh ne ise dal-badal kanun ke tahat karravaee ka aadhar batate hue sadasyata radd karne ki mang ki thi
